mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) and high housing starts (HOUST > 600) signal robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% AND HOUST > 600 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0% and HOUST > 600) feature stretched valuations and imminent policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% AND HOUST > 600 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in nonfarm employment (PAYEMS growth > 0%) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO growth < 0%) indicates weakening manufacturing activity and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth < 0% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment contraction regimes (UNRATE > 8.0% and PAYEMS growth < 0%) feature intensifying recessionary fears that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0% AND PAYEMS growth < 0% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
